segments.he: וְשֶׁיְּהוּ רוֹכְלִין מְחַזְּרִין בָּעֲיָירוֹת – מִשּׁוּם תַּכְשִׁיטֵי נָשִׁים, כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִתְגַּנּוּ עַל בַּעֲלֵיהֶם.
segments.en: The Gemara discusses the next of Ezra’s ordinances: «And that peddlers should circulate through» all «the towns.» This Gemara explains that this is «because» peddlers supply «women’s cosmetics,» and therefore Ezra instituted this practice «so that» women «should not become unattractive to their husbands.»
